mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates a weak labor market, signaling economic distress and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 4.0%), the market anticipates Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 800.0 (HOUST < 800.0) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where HOUST < 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 105 (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and unemployment is elevated (UNRATE > 5.0%), the market perceives an accommodative monetary policy stance, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer and housing demand regime (RSAFS > 440k and HOUST > 900.0), robust economic activity supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 440k and HOUST > 900.0.
